summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, disclosing a share buyback program where the issuer repurchased Class A ordinary shares for cancellation across 13 trading days (May 27-June 15, 2026) totaling ~7,470,402 shares at prices from $6.67 to $7.25 per share. Concurrently, 14,250 new shares were issued at $4.34 per share upon exercise of share awards under the incentive plan. The closing balance shows 819,446,941 shares outstanding with 24,863,842 ADSs reserved. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is an ongoing capital return via open-market repurchases, watch for monthly disclosure of further buyback activity and potential share cancellation progress.
